title: Triazoloquinoxalines-based DNA intercalators-Topo II inhibitors: design, synthesis, docking, ADMET and anti-proliferative evaluations.
authors: Elwan, Alaa; Sakr, Helmy; El-Helby, Abdel-Ghany A; El-Morsy, Ahmed; Abdelgawad, Mohamed A; Ghoneim, Mohammed M; El-Sherbiny, Mohamed; El-Adl, Khaled
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成三唑并喹喔啉类DNA嵌入剂并评估其拓扑异构酶II抑制活性，虽含分子对接但核心为药物化学与湿实验，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Sixteen [1, 2, 4]triazolo[4,3-a]quinoxalines as DNA intercalators-Topo II inhibitors have been prepared and their anticancer actions evaluated towards three cancer cell lines. The new compounds affected on high percentage of MCF-7. Derivatives 7e, 7c and 7b exhibited the highest anticancer activities. Their activities were higher than that of doxorubicin. Molecular docking studies showed that the HBA present in the chromophore, the substituted distal phenyl moiety and the extended linkers enable our derivatives to act as DNA binders. Also, the pyrazoline moiety formed six H-bonds and improved affinities with DNA active site. Finally, 7e, 7c and 7b exhibited the highest DNA affinities and act as traditional intercalators of DNA. The most active derivatives 7e, 7c, 7b, 7g and 6e were subjected to evaluate their Topo II inhibition and DNA binding actions. Derivative 7e exhibited the highest binding affinity. It intercalates DNA at IC(50) = 29.06 microM. Moreover, compound 7e potently intercalates DNA at an IC(50) value of 31.24 microM. Finally, compound 7e demonstrated the most potent Topo II inhibitor at a value of 0.890 microM. Compound 7c exhibited an equipotent IC(50) value (0.940 microM) to that of doxorubicin. Furthermore, derivatives 7b, 7c, 7e and 7g displayed a high ADMET profile.
abstract_zh: 已制备十六种[1,2,4]三唑并[4,3-a]喹喔啉类DNA嵌入剂-拓扑异构酶II抑制剂，并评估了其对三种癌细胞系的抗癌活性。新化合物对MCF-7细胞系表现出高比例的影响。衍生物7e、7c和7b显示出最高的抗癌活性，其活性高于多柔比星。分子对接研究表明，发色团中的HBA、取代的远端苯基部分以及延长的连接体使我们的衍生物能够作为DNA结合剂。此外，吡唑啉部分形成了六个氢键，并提高了与DNA活性位点的亲和力。最后，7e、7c和7b表现出最高的DNA亲和力，并作为DNA的传统嵌入剂。对最具活性的衍生物7e、7c、7b、7g和6e进行了拓扑异构酶II抑制和DNA结合作用的评估。衍生物7e表现出最高的结合亲和力，其以IC(50) = 29.06微摩尔嵌入DNA。此外，化合物7e在IC(50)值为31.24微摩尔时强力嵌入DNA。最后，化合物7e在0.890微摩尔值下表现出最强的拓扑异构酶II抑制作用。化合物7c表现出与多柔比星等效的IC(50)值（0.940微摩尔）。此外，衍生物7b、7c、7e和7g显示出较高的ADMET特性。
